# helm_api_client (`@helm/api-client-dart`)

Generated Dart client for Helm حلم `/v1` (consumed by `apps/helm_mobile`).

## DO NOT EDIT

Files under `lib/src/generated/` are **machine-generated** from `packages/openapi/openapi.yaml`.

1. Change the OpenAPI SoT.
2. Run `pnpm --filter @helm/api-client-dart codegen` (or root `pnpm codegen`).
3. Commit the regen output.

Hand edits will be overwritten and **CI fails** if regen is dirty.

When OpenAPI Generator / Dart tooling is available locally, the script prefers it; otherwise it writes a deterministic stub matching the `/v1` health/meta surface.
